title: Observation Stay Pricing Methodology — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Pricing methodology bulletin.** The observation pricing method values the observation lines (revenue code 0762) of an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) when it is valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

**Commercial HMO Claim for services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) — observation case rate.** The case rate packages the general pharmacy (revenue code 0250), is never above the billed charges of the observation and general pharmacy lines it packages, and follows the billed hours of G0378:

| Billed hours of G0378 | Case rate |
|---|---|
| 48 hours or more | 2640.00 USD |
| 24 hours or more and below 48 | 2150.00 USD |
| 8 hours or more and below 24 | 1460.00 USD |
| below 8 hours | 980.00 USD |
| no hour billed | no value |

**Commercial PPO Claim — per hour.** The billed hours, but no more than 48, times 58.00 USD, never above the observation charges.

**Otherwise.** The payer class's expected allowed percentage of the observation charges.

**General pharmacy.** The general pharmacy carries no value of its own only when the observation case rate that packages it is paid (the case-rate method with observation hours billed); otherwise it is valued at the expected allowed percentage of its charges.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, observation and pharmacy charges 6,000.00)**
- Commercial HMO Claim at Appleton, 23 hours → 1460.00; 24 hours → 2150.00; 47 hours → 2150.00; 48 hours → 2640.00; pharmacy 0.00 in each.
- Commercial HMO Claim at Appleton, no hour billed → observation lines no value; pharmacy at the expected allowed percentage.
- Commercial PPO Claim, 60 hours, observation charges 5,000.00 → 48 times 58.00 → 2,784.00.
